turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick check on our project metrics. What's the primary KPI we're using for the Long-running Agents that handle process ticketing?
Based on your previous notes, you identified Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR) as the key performance indicator for those specific agents. Is that still the focus?
Yes, exactly. MTTR is the one. By the way, did my package arrive today?
I don't have access to your shipping notifications, but I can help you draft an email to the vendor if it's missing.
Never mind, it's probably just the rain slowing things down. I'll check later.
Sounds good. Let me know if you need anything else regarding the agent metrics.
Lloyd, I caught up with Dalibor and Daniel today. It's interesting how their views on AI adoption speed diverge.
Oh? How do their perspectives differ?
Dalibor agrees with Daniel on the near term but not the far term regarding AI adoption speed. Daniel's much more optimistic long-term.
That’s a common split. Are you planning to adjust your strategy based on that?
Maybe. First, I need to fix this bug in my code. It's crashing on startup.
Do you have a stack trace?
Just a generic error. I'll dig into it. Thanks for listening.
